text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a branch of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand and work with human language. It is not just about reading words; it also involves understanding context, tone, and meaning. For example, NLP powers translation tools that convert text between languages while keeping the original message clear. It is also used in sentiment analysis, which helps companies know if customer reviews are positive or negative. Additionally, NLP is behind chatbots that can answer questions or provide support online. From simple spell-checking to complex conversations, NLP is changing how we interact with technology every day.
